description: Authenticates and returns a short-lived session token. Must be called first; the returned token is used as the Bearer auth value for every other endpoint.

auth.value: Static per-institution API key. Generated in droot/evolvo admin UI: Institutie -> Setari institutie -> Setari de comunicare cu sisteme AI -> Tip: 'Generic AI' -> set caller server IP(s) in 'Adresa IP' (semicolon-separated) -> 'Genereaza cheia API'. That same settings page shows the API URL and the current key.
auth.warning: The bearer token value checked into thirdpartyai-live.postman_collection_v3.json for this request is a stale/demo key and returns 401 (see errors below). Always use the real key from the admin settings page.

status_200.token: string - opaque session token, Bearer auth for all subsequent calls, valid for 1 hour

errors.meaning: Bad/stale API key, or caller IP not present in the institution's whitelisted IP list.
